translations.web: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
translations.bsb: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
translations.kjv: Wherefore I put ➔ thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
translations.asv: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.
